items.description: Heatmaps are dense matrices; visual inspection at full resolution is non-trivial. Mode A FIXED_PROBABILITY [0,1] view provides the absolute reference; Mode B case-shared view provides within-case comparison.
items.resolution_notes: Documented in attention_heatmap_report.md §5–§8; Mode A reference always rendered for shared top5 cases.

items.description: Same numeric head index across seeds is NOT assumed to represent the same learned semantic role. Cross-seed V2 grids display heads at matching architectural positions only.
items.resolution_notes: Documented caveat in every V2 grid caption and in attention_heatmap_report.md §12 and §14.
